mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a pickup in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month moving average, the tightening monetary policy and rising inflation lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bp in a quarter and CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month, not accompanied by a corresponding increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS), signals a labor market disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.5% in a month and PAYEMS does not increase correspondingly
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average, without a corresponding increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), signals a sustainable consumption growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 3-month MA and CPIAUCSL does not increase correspondingly
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
